value.body: Faculty at design schools — NIFT campuses, the NIDs, and design departments at IITs and other institutes — teach studio and theory courses, guide student projects, run industry collaborations and do research or practice. Posts run from Assistant Professor upwards, alongside visiting and contract faculty.

items.label: Typical qualification
items.value: Master’s in design or a related field

items.label: Recruitment
items.value: Each institute advertises its own posts

items.label: M.Des enrolment
items.note: About 60% women; one pool from which design faculty are drawn
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Ministry of Education (programme-wise enrolment, all modes)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Usually a master's degree in design or a related field, with professional or teaching experience for higher grades. Under UGC rules, university assistant professors need a master's with at least 55% plus NET, or a PhD. Selection is through portfolio review, a presentation or teaching demonstration, and interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Permanent openings are few and periodic; many people start as visiting or contract faculty.
Industry and portfolio experience count heavily in design schools.
A PhD increasingly matters for permanent and senior posts.
Teaching can run alongside your own practice, within institute rules.

value.title: M.Des enrolment in India
value.note: Based on institutions that responded to AISHE. Master's enrolment is a pipeline indicator, not a count of faculty openings.
value.source: AISHE 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24 reports, Ministry of Education (programme-wise enrolment, all modes)
